|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-83-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) may deploy –2 (to a maximum of –3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 11, slip 82. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 26). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “82” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “are deploy -2” for “may deploy –2” (it writes the Immune to Alter icon as “(Immune to Alter.)”, which is notation only): “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) are deploy -2 (to a maximum of -3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1261_83-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-moncalamaridockyards-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) may deploy –2 (to a maximum of –3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip prints “82”).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) may deploy –2 (to a maximum of –3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-83-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do).
